title: ModuleRuntimeAdapter
responsibility: Runs a unit in-process by calling its exported handler behind the runtime contract.

inputs.name: ModuleRuntimeAdapter.load.file
inputs.description: The module file to import, converted with `pathToFileURL` and imported on the first `invoke` that reaches the handler, not inside `load`. The import result is cached, so a missing or unloadable file makes every call that reaches the handler return a `runtime-unavailable` response, and the import is never retried.

inputs.name: ModuleRuntimeAdapter.load.handlerName
inputs.description: The name of the module export that is called with each request; it is looked up when the module is first imported and must be a function. If the module has no function export with this name, every call that reaches the handler returns a `runtime-unavailable` response whose message names the label and this handler name.

inputs.name: ModuleRuntimeAdapter.load.options
inputs.description: Optional runtime settings, defaulting to `{}`: `timeoutMs` caps each call (default `defaultRuntimeTimeoutMs`, 30000 ms) and `label` names the module in `runtime-unavailable` messages (default `file`). A handler that blocks the calling thread cannot be interrupted, so its late response is replaced by `runtime-timeout` only after it returns.

outputs.name: ModuleRuntimeAdapter.load
outputs.description: The new `ModuleRuntimeAdapter`, a `HandlerRuntimeAdapter` subclass with `kind` `'module'`, that imports its handler on the first `invoke` that reaches it and keeps that result for the life of the instance. A failed import or lookup is never thrown: each `invoke` that reaches the handler returns a `runtime-unavailable` response.
